declared: 2026-11-14, second step of the pIce-at-bound diagnosis (first step: lapsim-exp/trac-2026-11-14). F1 only. Finding from the trac screen: tracK at 0.6 halves the corner minimum bias but makes exit acceleration too low (2025, 100-140 km/h: real 7.86, sim 5.87 m/s2), so traction grip alone is the wrong lever. Hypothesis: the friction ellipse (exponent 2) lets the car brake and drive too hard while cornering. Candidate: LAPSIM_FEXP=on fits the exponent frictionExp per season in [1, 3] (the kernel allows no value below 1). Variants: A = production flags (baseline), K = A + FEXP, KT = A + FEXP + TRAC with tracK in [0.4, 1.1]. Fit length and held-out method: identical to the f1-converged run of the same day (convergence rule, warm folds, all 8 folds). Metrics: held-out RMS per season (gate.mjs), corner minimum bias, trap error, bound hits (exp-compare --physics). Pass: gate accepted on F1, F1 2025 and 2026 not worse than A, corner bias and trap error not worse, no new value at a bound. frictionExp or tracK at a bound is a finding and blocks acceptance. pIce and clA positions are reported. Local screens before this declaration (3 rounds, 60 iterations, no folds, not converged, fit error only): score A 26.21, T6 21.25, KT 19.90, K 19.15; K corner minimum bias 2025 -12.3 -> -4.3 km/h, 2026 -15.2 -> -5.3 km/h; K frictionExp 1.11 (2025), 1.01 (2026); pIce 2025 still at its bound in K, 0.90 of nominal in KT. No variants added after results.
